requirements.evidence: Contract is covered: entities migration with named unique slug and soft deletes (database/migrations/2026_10_29_063900_create_entities_table.php:17), memberships with cascade FKs, default role, named unique keys and stored owner_seq (2026_10_29_063901_create_entity_memberships_table.php:16-22), UserRole enum + manageable() (app/Models/UserRole.php:5-18), policies (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:11-36, app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:11-29), tenant middleware (app/Http/Middleware/ResolveCurrentEntity.php:31-71), slug retry on insert collision (app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:21-69), switcher/pick/dashboard/onboarding routes with auth+verified (routes/web.php:40-66), lang keys in both locales (lang/en/ui.php:50-56, lang/pt_BR/ui.php:50-56) and updated docs (docs/database-schema.md:761,812-813). Gaps: routes/web.php:28-30 dereferences a null Entity for a soft-deleted sole entity, and resources/views/entity/switcher.blade.php:7 reads the session key directly instead of the resolved tenant.

conventions.evidence: Good: #[Validate] + $this->validate() (CreateEntity.php:18-23), policies registered via Gate::policy (app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:30-31), $fillable on new models (app/Models/Entity.php:18, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:16), generated-looking migrations with reversible down(), Blade components reused (x-form-field, x-button, x-layouts::default-page), docs and CHANGELOG updated. Deviations: entity creation/membership/audit is a domain write done inline instead of an app/Actions/* class (CreateEntity.php:21-69), entity.pick authorizes with an inline membership check instead of the policy (routes/web.php:51), custom current_entity middleware is only aliased (bootstrap/app.php:16) and never registered with Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, and new models use $fillable while the sibling User model uses #[Fillable] (app/Models/User.php:19-21).

security.evidence: Authorization and validation are present: $this->authorize('create', Entity::class) (CreateEntity.php:25), $this->authorize('view', $entity) in mount (app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:15), 403 for non-members of the session entity (ResolveCurrentEntity.php:31-34) and of the picked entity (routes/web.php:51-52), #[Validate('required|string|max:255')] (CreateEntity.php:18), explicit $fillable on both models, @csrf and auto-escaped output in the switcher (resources/views/entity/switcher.blade.php:5-8); the owner role is never taken from input (CreateEntity.php:140-144). Gap: the custom tenant middleware is not a Livewire persistent middleware, so it does not re-run on /livewire/update requests.

tests.evidence: The diff adds no tests at all: 'grep tests/' change.diff returns nothing and every changed file is production code, docs or lang. No test covers the migrations/constraints, the policies, the tenant middleware, the /home dispatch, the switcher/pick routes or the two Livewire components, so there is no happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call or tamper test for CreateEntity::submit (conventions: no production code without a test, and unauthorized/tamper tests for every Livewire action).

simplicity.evidence: The 0/1/>1 membership dispatch is implemented twice (routes/web.php:18-33 and ResolveCurrentEntity.php:50-71), and the tenant context is published three ways at once (Tenant::set, request attribute and app()->instance at ResolveCurrentEntity.php:43-45) although nothing in the diff consumes them; App\Support\Tenant (app/Support/Tenant.php:7-24) is an extra wrapper for the container binding. Otherwise the code is direct and reuses existing helpers (Str::slug, Livewire validation, Blade components).

readability.evidence: Small focused methods with clear names (EntityMembership scopes at app/Models/EntityMembership.php:42-63, policy methods at app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:11-36), docblocks on relations/scopes, readable Blade. Minor inconsistencies: the 0/1/>1 logic is duplicated across two files, and the layout is referenced as 'layouts::default-page' (CreateEntity.php:101, Dashboard.php:23, switcher.blade.php:1) while the existing layout is resources/views/layouts/default-page.blade.php.

scope.evidence: Every file in the diff serves the task: migrations, models/enum, factories, policies, middleware, Livewire components, routes, lang, views, plus the required docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG updates (change.diff:9, 761-822). No members/settings pages, Accept-Language middleware, navbar redesign or other out-of-scope work.

issues.explanation: The change ships zero Pest/PHPUnit tests although every new behavior (constraints, policies, middleware, routes, both Livewire components) requires tests, including an unauthorized-call and a tamper test for CreateEntity::submit.

The custom current_entity middleware is only aliased, not registered via Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, so it silently stops applying to Dashboard's /livewire/update requests and the tenant context/authorization is gone after the initial page load.

POST entity.pick performs its authorization with an inline membershipFor() check instead of going through the EntityPolicy (e.g. $user->can('view', $entity)), contrary to the rule that authorization always goes through policies/gates.

Creating the entity plus owner membership, audit log and session change is a domain write implemented inline in the component rather than in an app/Actions/* use-case class as the conventions require (cf. CreateQueue).

In the one-membership /home branch Entity::find() can return null for a soft-deleted entity, and route('entity.dashboard', ['entity' => null]) then throws a missing-parameter UrlGenerationException (the middleware handles this null case, this path does not).

The switcher reads session('current_entity_id') directly, although the task says only the HTTP layer reads it and the middleware resolves it into a tenant context; the switcher route also does not run current_entity, so the highlight bypasses the tenant context entirely.

The layout is referenced as 'layouts::default-page', but the existing layout view is resources/views/layouts/default-page.blade.php (view name layouts.default-page) and no 'layouts' view-namespace registration appears in the diff; verify, because if only a component namespace exists these pages fail with a view-not-found error.
The tenant context is set three times (Tenant::set, request attribute and app()->instance) and nothing in the change consumes any of them; one mechanism would be enough.
The 0/1/>1 membership dispatch is duplicated from ResolveCurrentEntity.php:50-71, so the same routing policy lives in two places and can drift.
New models declare protected $fillable while the sibling User model uses the #[Fillable] attribute style; matching the sibling style would be more consistent.
The newly added public membershipFor() has no PHPDoc, while the relations added next to it do and the conventions ask for PHPDoc on touched public methods.

review.summary: The change implements the entities/memberships schema, enum, factories, policies, tenant middleware, onboarding, switcher, dashboard and /home dispatch with docs and both locales, and the implementation reads as largely correct. It is not approvable because it ships no tests whatsoever for any of the new behavior, and it also deviates from the project's action/policy/persistent-middleware conventions. Smaller defects (null Entity in the /home redirect, direct session read in the switcher, the unverified 'layouts::' view namespace) should be fixed while the test suite is added.
